The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor.
canavar.black-pudding/reaction:split: Trigger: While the pudding is Large or Medium and has 10+ Hit Points, it becomes Bloodied or is subjected to Lightning or Slashing damage. Response: The pudding splits into two new Black Puddings. Each new pudding is one size smaller than the original pudding and acts on its Initiative. The original pudding’s Hit Points are divided evenly between the new puddings (round down).
canavar.black-pudding/trait:amorphous: The pudding can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
canavar.black-pudding/trait:corrosive-form: A creature that hits the pudding with a melee attack roll takes 4 (1d8) Acid damage. Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the pudding and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the pudding and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon. In 1 minute, the pudding can eat through 2 feet of nonmagical wood or metal.
canavar.black-pudding/trait:spider-climb: The pudding can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
canavar.blink-dog/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.blink-dog/bonus:teleport: The dog teleports up to 40 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
canavar.blood-hawk/action:beak: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage, or 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage if the target is Bloodied.
canavar.blood-hawk/trait:pack-tactics: The hawk has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hawk’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.blue-dragon-wyrmling/action:lightning-br: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 21 (6d6) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.blue-dragon-wyrmling/action:multiattack: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.blue-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Lightning damage.
canavar.boar/action:gore: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 3 (1d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.
canavar.boar/trait:bloodied-fury: While Bloodied, the boar has Advantage on attack rolls.
canavar.bone-devil/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Slashing damage.
canavar.bone-devil/action:infernal-sting: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Piercing damage plus 18 (4d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the start of the devil’s next turn. While Poisoned, the target can’t regain Hit Points.
canavar.bone-devil/action:multiattack: The devil makes two Claw attacks and one Infernal Sting attack.
canavar.bone-devil/trait:diabolical-restoration: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
canavar.bone-devil/trait:magic-resistance: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.brass-dragon-wyrmling/action:fire-breath: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 14 (4d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.brass-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
canavar.brass-dragon-wyrmling/action:sleep-breat: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, at which point it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Unconscious condition for 1 minute. This effect ends for the target if it takes damage or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it.
canavar.bronze-dragon-wyrmling/action:lightning-: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 40-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 16 (3d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.bronze-dragon-wyrmling/action:multiattac: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.bronze-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.bronze-dragon-wyrmling/action:repulsion-: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: The target is pushed up to 30 feet straight away from the dragon and has the Prone condition.
canavar.bronze-dragon-wyrmling/trait:amphibious: The dragon can breathe air and water.
canavar.brown-bear/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.brown-bear/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.brown-bear/action:multiattack: The bear makes one Bite attack and one Claw attack.
canavar.bugbear-stalker/action:javelin: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +5, reach 10 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.bugbear-stalker/action:morningstar: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. Hit: 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.bugbear-stalker/action:multiattack: The bugbear makes two Javelin or Morningstar attacks.
canavar.bugbear-stalker/bonus:quick-grapple: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one Medium or smaller creature the bugbear can see within 10 feet. Failure: The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13).
canavar.bugbear-stalker/trait:abduct: The bugbear needn’t spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.
canavar.bugbear-warrior/action:grab: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).
canavar.bugbear-warrior/action:light-hammer: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the bugbear), reach 10 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 9 (3d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.bugbear-warrior/trait:abduct: The bugbear needn’t spend extra movement to move a creature it is grappling.
canavar.bulette/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.bulette/action:deadly-leap: The bulette spends 5 feet of movement to jump to a space within 15 feet that contains one or more Large or smaller creatures. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in the bulette’s destination space. Failure: 19 (3d12) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage, and the target is pushed 5 feet straight away from the bulette.
canavar.bulette/action:multiattack: The bulette makes two Bite attacks.
canavar.bulette/bonus:leap: The bulette jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
canavar.camel/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.cat/action:scratch: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.
canavar.cat/trait:jumper: The cat’s jump distance is determined using its Dexterity rather than its Strength.
canavar.centaur-trooper/action:longbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.centaur-trooper/action:multiattack: The centaur makes two attacks, using Pike or Longbow in any combination.
canavar.centaur-trooper/action:pike: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.centaur-trooper/bonus:trampling-charge: The centaur moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and can move through the spaces of Medium or smaller creatures. Each creature whose space the centaur enters is targeted once by the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 14. Failure: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition.
canavar.chain-devil/action:chain: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two chains, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
canavar.chain-devil/action:conjure-infernal-chai: The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the devil can see within 60 feet. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Fire damage, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil’s next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to 30 feet straight toward itself. Success: The chain disappears.
canavar.chain-devil/action:multiattack: The devil makes two Chain attacks and uses Conjure Infernal Chain.
canavar.chain-devil/reaction:unnerving-gaze: Trigger: A creature the devil can see starts its turn within 30 feet of the devil and can see the devil. Response—Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, the triggering creature. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. Success: The target is immune to this devil’s Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours.
canavar.chain-devil/trait:diabolical-restoration: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
canavar.chain-devil/trait:magic-resistance: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.chimera/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage, or 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage if the chimera had Advantage on the attack roll.
canavar.chimera/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
canavar.chimera/action:fire-breath: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 31 (7d8) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.chimera/action:multiattack: The chimera makes one Ram attack, one Bite attack, and one Claw attack. It can replace the Claw attack with a use of Fire Breath if available.
canavar.chimera/action:ram: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.chuul/action:multiattack: The chuul makes two Pincer attacks and uses Paralyzing Tentacles.
canavar.chuul/action:paralyzing-tentacles: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature Grappled by the chuul. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. While Poisoned, the target has the Paralyzed condition.
canavar.chuul/action:pincer: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from one of two pincers.
canavar.chuul/trait:amphibious: The chuul can breathe air and water.
canavar.chuul/trait:sense-magic: The chuul senses magic within 120 feet of itself. This trait otherwise works like the Detect Magic spell but isn’t itself magical.
canavar.clay-golem/action:multiattack: The golem makes two Slam attacks, or it makes three Slam attacks if it used Hasten this turn.
canavar.clay-golem/action:slam: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 6 (1d12) Acid damage, and the target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the Acid damage taken.
canavar.clay-golem/bonus:hasten: The golem takes the Dash and Disengage actions.
canavar.clay-golem/trait:acid-absorption: Whenever the golem is subjected to Acid damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Acid damage dealt.
canavar.clay-golem/trait:berserk: Whenever the golem starts its turn Bloodied, roll 1d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to be berserk until it is destroyed or it is no longer Bloodied.
canavar.clay-golem/trait:magic-resistance: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.cloaker/action:attach: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the cloaker attaches to it. While the cloaker is attached, the target has the Blinded condition, and the cloaker can’t make Attach attacks against other targets. In addition, the cloaker halves the damage it takes (round down), and the target takes the same amount of damage. The cloaker can detach itself by spending 5 feet of movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can take an action to try to detach the cloaker, doing so by succeeding on a DC 14 Strength (Athletics) check.
canavar.cloaker/action:multiattack: The cloaker makes one Attach attack and two Tail attacks.
canavar.cloaker/action:tail: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.cloaker/bonus:moan: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 60-foot Emanation originating from the cloaker. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the cloaker’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this cloaker’s Moan for the next 24 hours.
canavar.cloaker/bonus:phantasms: The cloaker casts the Mirror Image spell, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability. The spell ends early if the cloaker starts or ends its turn in Bright Light.
canavar.cloaker/trait:light-sensitivity: While in Bright Light, the cloaker has Disadvantage on attack rolls.
canavar.cloud-giant/action:multiattack: The giant makes two attacks, using Thunderous Mace or Thundercloud in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Spellcasting to cast Fog Cloud.
canavar.cloud-giant/action:spellcasting: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Detect Magic, Fog Cloud, Light 1/Day Each: Control Weather, Gaseous Form, Telekinesis
canavar.cloud-giant/action:thundercloud: Ranged Attack Roll: +12, range 240 ft. Hit: 18 (3d6 + 8) Thunder damage, and the target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn.
canavar.cloud-giant/action:thunderous-mace: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 21 (3d8 + 8) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.
canavar.cloud-giant/bonus:misty-step: The giant casts the Misty Step spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.cockatrice/action:petrifying-bite: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition. The target repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition, instead of the Restrained condition, for 24 hours.
canavar.commoner/action:club: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.commoner/trait:training: The commoner has proficiency in one skill of the GM’s choice and has Advantage whenever it makes an ability check using that skill.
canavar.constrictor-snake/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.constrictor-snake/action:constrict: Strength Saving Throw: DC 12, one Medium or smaller creature the snake can see within 5 feet. Failure: 7 (3d4) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).
canavar.copper-dragon-wyrmling/action:acid-breat: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 20-foot-long, 5-footwide Line. Failure: 18 (4d8) Acid damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.copper-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
canavar.copper-dragon-wyrmling/action:slowing-br: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target can’t take Reactions; its Speed is halved; and it can take either an action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. This effect lasts until the end of its next turn.
canavar.couatl/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (1d12 + 5) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the couatl’s next turn.
canavar.couatl/action:constrict: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature the couatl can see within 5 feet. Failure: 8 (1d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
canavar.couatl/action:spellcasting: The couatl casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell) 1/Day Each: Create Food and Water, Dream, Greater Restoration, Scrying, Sleep
canavar.couatl/bonus:divine-aid: The couatl casts Bless, Lesser Restoration, or Sanctuary, requiring no spell components and using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.couatl/trait:shielded-mind: The couatl’s thoughts can’t be read by any means, and other creatures can communicate with it telepathically only if it allows them.
canavar.crab/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.crab/trait:amphibious: The crab can breathe air and water.
canavar.crocodile/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.
canavar.crocodile/trait:hold-breath: The crocodile can hold its breath for 1 hour.
canavar.cultist-fanatic/action:pact-blade: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
canavar.cultist-fanatic/action:spellcasting: The cultist casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: Light, Thaumaturgy 2/Day: Command 1/Day: Hold Person
canavar.cultist-fanatic/bonus:spiritual-weapon: The cultist casts the Spiritual Weapon spell, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.cultist/action:ritual-sickle: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 1 Necrotic damage.
canavar.darkmantle/action:crush: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage, and the darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack roll, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attack rolls. Its Speed becomes 0, it can’t benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful DC 13 Strength (Athletics) check. On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using 5 feet of movement.
canavar.darkmantle/action:darkness-aura: Magical Darkness fills a 15-foot Emanation originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can’t penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.
canavar.death-dog/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a creature, it is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. First Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition. While Poisoned, the target’s Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and it repeats the save every 24 hours that elapse, ending the effect on itself on a success. Subsequent Failures: The Poisoned target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by 5 (1d10).
canavar.death-dog/action:multiattack: The death dog makes two Bite attacks.
canavar.deer/action:ram: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.deer/trait:agile: The deer doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it moves out of an enemy’s reach.
canavar.deva/action:holy-mace: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.
canavar.deva/action:multiattack: The deva makes two Holy Mace attacks.
canavar.deva/action:spellcasting: The deva casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Shapechange (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell) 1/Day Each: Commune, Raise Dead
canavar.deva/bonus:divine-aid: The deva casts Cure Wounds, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.deva/trait:exalted-restoration: If the deva dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.
canavar.deva/trait:magic-resistance: The deva has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.dire-wolf/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.dire-wolf/trait:pack-tactics: The wolf has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the wolf’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.djinni/action:create-whirlwind: The djinni conjures a whirlwind at a point it can see within 120 feet. The whirlwind fills a 20-foot-radius, 60-foot-high Cylinder centered on that point. The whirlwind lasts until the djinni’s Concentration on it ends. The djinni can move the whirlwind up to 20 feet at the start of each of its turns. Whenever the whirlwind enters a creature’s space or a creature enters the whirlwind, that creature is subjected to the following effect. Strength Saving Throw: DC 17 (a creature makes this save only once per turn, and the djinni is unaffected). Failure: While in the whirlwind, the target has the Restrained condition and moves with the whirlwind. At the start of each of its turns, the Restrained target takes 21 (6d6) Thunder damage. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
canavar.djinni/action:multiattack: The djinni makes three attacks, using Storm Blade or Storm Bolt in any combination.
canavar.djinni/action:spellcasting: The djinni casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17): At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic 2/Day Each: Create Food and Water (can create wine instead of water), Tongues, Wind Walk 1/Day Each: Creation, Gaseous Form, Invisibility, Major Image, Plane Shift
canavar.djinni/action:storm-blade: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 feet. Hit: 12 (2d6 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Lightning damage.
canavar.djinni/action:storm-bolt: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 feet. Hit: 13 (3d8) Thunder damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.djinni/trait:elemental-restoration: If the djinni dies outside the Elemental Plane of Air, its body dissolves into mist, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere on the Plane of Air.
canavar.djinni/trait:magic-resistance: The djinni has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.djinni/trait:wishes: The djinni has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the djinni knows it, the djinni can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the djinni can understand. If the djinni casts the spell for the creature, the djinni suffers none of the spell’s stress. Once the djinni has cast it three times, the djinni can’t do so again for 365 days.
canavar.doppelganger/action:multiattack: The doppelganger makes two Slam attacks and uses Unsettling Visage if available.
canavar.doppelganger/action:read-thoughts: The doppelganger casts Detect Thoughts, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12).
canavar.doppelganger/action:slam: Melee Attack Roll: +6 (with Advantage during the first round of each combat), reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.doppelganger/action:unsettling-visage: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the doppelganger that can see the doppelganger. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
canavar.doppelganger/bonus:shape-shift: The doppelganger shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
canavar.draft-horse/action:hooves: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.dragon-turtle/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +13, reach 15 ft. Hit: 23 (3d10 + 7) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.
canavar.dragon-turtle/action:multiattack: The dragon makes three Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.

If this check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk until the start of its next turn, at which point it resumes rolling for the Berserk trait again if it is still Bloodied.
canavar.flesh-golem/trait:lightning-absorption: Whenever the golem is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.
canavar.flesh-golem/trait:magic-resistance: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

canavar.gelatinous-cube/action:engulf: The cube moves up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The cube can move through the spaces of Large or smaller creatures if it has room inside itself to contain them (see the Ooze Cube trait). Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature whose space the cube enters for the first time during this move. Failure: 10 (3d6) Acid damage, and the target is engulfed. An engulfed target is suffocating, can’t cast spells with a Verbal component, has the Restrained condition, and takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the start of each of the cube’s turns. When the cube moves, the engulfed target moves with it. An engulfed target can try to escape by taking an action to make a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check. On a successful check, the target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space. Success: Half damage, and the target moves to an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the cube. If there is no unoccupied space, the target fails the save instead.
canavar.gelatinous-cube/action:pseudopod: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (3d6 + 2) Acid damage.
canavar.gelatinous-cube/trait:ooze-cube: The cube fills its entire space and is transparent. Other creatures can enter that space, but a creature that does so is subjected to the cube’s Engulf and has Disadvantage on the saving throw. Creatures inside the cube have Total Cover, and the cube can hold one Large creature or up to four Medium or Small creatures inside itself at a time. As an action, a creature within 5 feet of the cube can pull a creature or an object out of the cube by succeeding on a DC 12 Strength (Athletics) check, and the puller takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage.
canavar.gelatinous-cube/trait:transparent: Even when the cube is in plain sight, a creature must succeed on a DC 15 Wisdom (Perception) check to notice the cube if the creature hasn’t witnessed the cube move or otherwise act.

canavar.ghost/action:possession: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 13, one Humanoid the ghost can see within 5 feet. Failure: The target is possessed by the ghost; the ghost disappears, and the target has the Incapacitated condition and loses control of its body. The ghost now controls the body, but the target retains awareness. The ghost can’t be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that specifically target Undead. The ghost’s game statistics are the same, except it uses the possessed target’s Speed, as well as the target’s Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution modifiers. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 Hit Points or the ghost leaves as a Bonus Action. When the possession ends, the ghost appears in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the target, and the target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours. Success: The target is immune to this ghost’s Possession for 24 hours.

canavar.giant-lizard/trait:spider-climb: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

canavar.giant-octopus/reaction:ink-cloud: Trigger: The octopus takes damage while underwater. Response: The octopus releases ink that fills a 10-foot Cube centered on itself, and the octopus moves up to its Swim Speed. The Cube is Heavily Obscured for 1 minute or until a strong current or similar effect disperses the ink.
canavar.giant-octopus/trait:water-breathing: The octopus can breathe only underwater. It can hold its breath for 1 hour outside water.
canavar.giant-owl/action:spellcasting: The owl casts one of the following spells, requiring no spell components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability: At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Detect Magic 1/Day: Clairvoyance
canavar.giant-owl/action:talons: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage.
canavar.giant-owl/trait:flyby: The owl doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
canavar.giant-rat/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 feet. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.giant-rat/trait:pack-tactics: The rat has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the rat’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.giant-scorpion/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13) from one of two claws.
canavar.giant-scorpion/action:multiattack: The scorpion makes two Claw attacks and one Sting attack.
canavar.giant-scorpion/action:sting: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.
canavar.giant-seahorse/action:ram: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Bludgeoning damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Bludgeoning damage if the seahorse moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
canavar.giant-seahorse/bonus:bubble-dash: While underwater, the seahorse moves up to half its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
canavar.giant-seahorse/trait:water-breathing: The seahorse can breathe only underwater.
canavar.giant-shark/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +9 (with Advantage if the target doesn’t have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Piercing damage.
canavar.giant-shark/action:multiattack: The shark makes two Bite attacks.
canavar.giant-shark/trait:water-breathing: The shark can breathe only underwater.
canavar.giant-spider/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
canavar.giant-spider/action:web: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the spider can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Restrained condition until the web is destroyed (AC 10; HP 5; Vulnerability to Fire damage; Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage).
canavar.giant-spider/trait:spider-climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
canavar.giant-spider/trait:web-walker: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and it knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
canavar.giant-toad/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12).
canavar.giant-toad/action:swallow: The toad swallows a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. While swallowed, the target isn’t Grappled but has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the toad. In addition, the target takes 10 (3d6) Acid damage at the end of each of the toad’s turns. The toad can have only one target swallowed at a time, and it can’t use Bite while it has a swallowed target. If the toad dies, a swallowed creature is no longer Restrained and can escape from the corpse using 5 feet of movement, exiting with the Prone condition.
canavar.giant-toad/trait:amphibious: The toad can breathe air and water.
canavar.giant-toad/trait:standing-leap: The toad’s Long Jump is up to 20 feet and its High Jump is up to 10 feet with or without a running start.
canavar.giant-venomous-snake/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Poison damage.
canavar.giant-vulture/action:gouge: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
canavar.giant-vulture/trait:pack-tactics: The vulture has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the vulture’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.giant-wasp/action:sting: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
canavar.giant-wasp/trait:flyby: The wasp doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
canavar.giant-weasel/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.giant-wolf-spider/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
canavar.giant-wolf-spider/trait:spider-climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
canavar.gibbering-mouther/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition. The target dies if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack. Its body is then absorbed into the mouther, leaving only equipment behind.
canavar.gibbering-mouther/action:blinding-spittl: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point within 30 feet. Failure: 7 (2d6) Radiant damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the end of the mouther’s next turn.
canavar.gibbering-mouther/trait:aberrant-ground: The ground in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the mouther is Difficult Terrain.
canavar.gibbering-mouther/trait:gibbering: The mouther babbles incoherently while it doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 10, any creature that starts its turn within 20 feet of the mouther while it is babbling. Failure: The target rolls 1d8 to determine what it does during the current turn: 1–4. The target does nothing. 5–6. The target takes no action or Bonus Action and uses all its movement to move in a random direction. 7–8. The target makes a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach or does nothing if it can’t make such an attack.
canavar.glabrezu/action:multiattack: The glabrezu makes two Pincer attacks and uses Pummel or Spellcasting.
canavar.glabrezu/action:pincer: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 10 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 15) from one of two pincers.
canavar.glabrezu/action:pummel: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature Grappled by the glabrezu. Failure: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.glabrezu/action:spellcasting: The glabrezu casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Darkness, Detect Magic, Dispel Magic 1/Day Each: Confusion, Fly, Power Word Stun
canavar.glabrezu/trait:demonic-restoration: If the glabrezu dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
canavar.glabrezu/trait:magic-resistance: The glabrezu has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.gladiator/action:multiattack: The gladiator makes three Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Shield Bash.
canavar.gladiator/action:shield-bash: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature within 5 feet that the gladiator can see. Failure: 9 (2d4 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.gladiator/action:spear: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.gladiator/reaction:parry: Trigger: The gladiator is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The gladiator adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
canavar.gnoll-warrior/action:bone-bow: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d10 + 1) Piercing damage.
canavar.gnoll-warrior/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.gnoll-warrior/bonus:rampage: Immediately after dealing damage to a creature that is already Bloodied, the gnoll moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one Rend attack.
canavar.goat/action:ram: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Bludgeoning damage, or 2 (1d4) Bludgeoning damage if the goat moved 20+ feet straight toward the target immediately before the hit.
canavar.goblin-boss/action:multiattack: The goblin makes two attacks, using Scimitar or Shortbow in any combination.
canavar.goblin-boss/action:scimitar: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
canavar.goblin-boss/action:shortbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
canavar.goblin-boss/bonus:nimble-escape: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
canavar.goblin-boss/reaction:redirect-attack: Trigger: A creature the goblin can see makes an attack roll against it. Response: The goblin chooses a Small or Medium ally within 5 feet of itself. The goblin and that ally swap places, and the ally becomes the target of the attack instead.
canavar.goblin-minion/action:dagger: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.goblin-minion/bonus:nimble-escape: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
canavar.goblin-warrior/action:scimitar: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Slashing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Slashing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
canavar.goblin-warrior/action:shortbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage, plus 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the attack roll had Advantage.
canavar.goblin-warrior/bonus:nimble-escape: The goblin takes the Disengage or Hide action.
canavar.gold-dragon-wyrmling/action:fire-breath: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 22 (4d10) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.gold-dragon-wyrmling/action:multiattack: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.gold-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
canavar.gold-dragon-wyrmling/action:weakening-br: Strength Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature that isn’t currently affected by this breath in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 2 (1d4) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
canavar.gold-dragon-wyrmling/trait:amphibious: The dragon can breathe air and water.
canavar.gorgon/action:gore: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (2d12 + 5) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the gorgon moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.
canavar.gorgon/action:petrifying-breath: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.
canavar.gorgon/bonus:trample: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.gray-ooze/action:pseudopod: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d8 + 1) Acid damage. Nonmagical armor worn by the target takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers. The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor.
canavar.gray-ooze/trait:amorphous: The ooze can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
canavar.gray-ooze/trait:corrosive-form: Nonmagical ammunition is destroyed immediately after hitting the ooze and dealing any damage. Any nonmagical weapon takes a cumulative −1 penalty to attack rolls immediately after dealing damage to the ooze and coming into contact with it. The weapon is destroyed if the penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the weapon. The ooze can eat through 2-inch-thick, nonmagical metal or wood in 1 round.
canavar.green-dragon-wyrmling/action:multiattack: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.green-dragon-wyrmling/action:poison-brea: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 21 (6d6) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.green-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
canavar.green-dragon-wyrmling/trait:amphibious: The dragon can breathe air and water.
canavar.green-hag/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
canavar.green-hag/action:multiattack: The hag makes two Claw attacks.
canavar.green-hag/action:spellcasting: The hag casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 12, +4 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: Dancing Lights, Disguise Self (24-hour duration), Invisibility (self only, and the hag leaves no tracks while Invisible), Minor Illusion, Ray of Sickness (level 3 version)
canavar.green-hag/trait:amphibious: The hag can breathe air and water.
canavar.green-hag/trait:coven-magic: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.
canavar.green-hag/trait:mimicry: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations only with a successful DC 14 Wisdom (Insight) check.
canavar.grick/action:beak: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.grick/action:multiattack: The grick makes one Beak attack and one Tentacles attack.
canavar.grick/action:tentacles: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d10 + 2) Slashing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12) from all four tentacles.
canavar.griffon/action:multiattack: The griffon makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.griffon/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d8 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14) from both of the griffon’s front claws.
canavar.grimlock/action:bone-cudgel: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 2 (1d4) Psychic damage.
canavar.guard-captain/action:javelin: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.guard-captain/action:longsword: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Slashing damage.
canavar.guard-captain/action:multiattack: The guard makes two attacks, using Javelin or Longsword in any combination.
canavar.guard/action:spear: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage.
canavar.guardian-naga/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 17 (2d12 + 4) Piercing damage plus 22 (4d10) Poison damage.
canavar.guardian-naga/action:multiattack: The naga makes two Bite attacks. It can replace any attack with a use of Poisonous Spittle.
canavar.guardian-naga/action:poisonous-spittle: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the naga can see within 60 feet. Failure: 31 (7d8) Poison damage, and the target has the Blinded condition until the start of the naga’s next turn. Success: Half damage only.
canavar.guardian-naga/action:spellcasting: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Thaumaturgy 1/Day Each: Clairvoyance, Cure Wounds (level 6 version), Flame Strike (level 6 version), Geas, True Seeing
canavar.guardian-naga/trait:celestial-restoratio: If the naga dies, it returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points unless Dispel Evil and Good is cast on its remains.
canavar.half-dragon/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait.
canavar.half-dragon/action:dragons-breath: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 14, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 28 (8d6) damage of the type chosen for the Draconic Origin trait. Success: Half damage.
canavar.half-dragon/action:multiattack: The half-dragon makes two Claw attacks.
canavar.half-dragon/bonus:leap: The half-dragon jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
canavar.half-dragon/trait:draconic-origin: The half-dragon is related to a type of dragon associated with one of the following damage types (GM’s choice): Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison. This choice affects other aspects of the stat block.
canavar.harpy/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Slashing damage.
canavar.harpy/action:luring-song: The harpy sings a magical melody, which lasts until the harpy’s Concentration ends on it. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, each Humanoid and Giant in a 300-foot Emanation originating from the harpy when the song starts. Failure: The target has the Charmed condition until the song ends and repeats the save at the end of each of its turns. While Charmed, the target has the Incapacitated condition and ignores the Luring Song of other harpies. If the target is more than 5 feet from the harpy, the target moves on its turn toward the harpy by the most direct route, trying to get within 5 feet of the harpy. It doesn’t avoid Opportunity Attacks; however, before moving into damaging terrain (such as lava or a pit) and whenever it takes damage from a source other than the harpy, the target repeats the save. Success: The target is immune to this harpy’s Luring Song for 24 hours.
canavar.hawk/action:talons: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Slashing damage.
canavar.hell-hound/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
canavar.hell-hound/action:fire-breath: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 12, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 17 (5d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.hell-hound/action:multiattack: The hound makes two Bite attacks.
canavar.hell-hound/trait:pack-tactics: The hound has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hound’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.hezrou/action:multiattack: The hezrou makes three Rend attacks.

canavar.hezrou/bonus:leap: The hezrou jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
canavar.hezrou/trait:demonic-restoration: If the hezrou dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
canavar.hezrou/trait:magic-resistance: The hezrou has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.hezrou/trait:stench: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hezrou. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn.
canavar.hill-giant/action:multiattack: The giant makes two attacks, using Tree Club or Trash Lob in any combination.
canavar.hill-giant/action:trash-lob: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn.
canavar.hill-giant/action:tree-club: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (3d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.hippogriff/action:multiattack: The hippogriff makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.hippogriff/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.hippogriff/trait:flyby: The hippogriff doesn’t provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy’s reach.
canavar.hippopotamus/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Piercing damage.
canavar.hippopotamus/action:multiattack: The hippopotamus makes two Bite attacks.
canavar.hippopotamus/trait:hold-breath: The hippopotamus can hold its breath for 10 minutes.
canavar.hobgoblin-captain/action:greatsword: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
canavar.hobgoblin-captain/action:longbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) Poison damage.
canavar.hobgoblin-captain/action:multiattack: The hobgoblin makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.
canavar.hobgoblin-captain/trait:aura-of-authorit: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.hobgoblin-warrior/action:longbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +3, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage plus 7 (3d4) Poison damage.
canavar.hobgoblin-warrior/action:longsword: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 12 (2d10 + 1) Slashing damage.
canavar.hobgoblin-warrior/trait:pack-tactics: The hobgoblin has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hobgoblin’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.homunculus/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target is subjected to the following effect. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 12. Failure: The target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the homunculus’s next turn. Failure by 5 or More: The target has the Poisoned condition for 1 minute. While Poisoned, the target has the Unconscious condition, which ends early if the target takes any damage.
canavar.homunculus/trait:telepathic-bond: While the homunculus is on the same plane of existence as its master, the two of them can communicate telepathically with each other.
canavar.horned-devil/action:hurl-flame: Ranged Attack Roll: +8, range 150 ft. Hit: 26 (5d8 + 4) Fire damage. If the target is a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning.
canavar.horned-devil/action:infernal-tail: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the devil can see within 10 feet. Failure: 10 (1d8 + 6) Necrotic damage, and the target receives an infernal wound if it doesn’t have one. While wounded, the target loses 10 (3d6) Hit Points at the start of each of its turns. The wound closes after 1 minute, after a spell restores Hit Points to the target, or after the target or a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to stanch the wound, doing so by succeeding on a DC 17 Wisdom (Medicine) check.
canavar.horned-devil/action:multiattack: The devil makes three attacks, using Searing Fork or Hurl Flame in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Infernal Tail.
canavar.horned-devil/action:searing-fork: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) Fire damage.
canavar.horned-devil/trait:diabolical-restoratio: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
canavar.horned-devil/trait:magic-resistance: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
