canavar.hunter-shark/trait:water-breathing: The shark can breathe only underwater.
canavar.hydra/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Piercing damage.
canavar.hydra/action:multiattack: The hydra makes as many Bite attacks as it has heads.
canavar.hydra/trait:hold-breath: The hydra can hold its breath for 1 hour.
canavar.hydra/trait:multiple-heads: The hydra has five heads. Whenever the hydra takes 25 damage or more on a single turn, one of its heads dies. The hydra dies if all its heads are dead. At the end of each of its turns when it has at least one living head, the hydra grows two heads for each of its heads that died since its last turn, unless it has taken Fire damage since its last turn. The hydra regains 20 Hit Points when it grows new heads.
canavar.hydra/trait:reactive-heads: For each head the hydra has beyond one, it gets an extra Reaction that can be used only for Opportunity Attacks.
canavar.hyena/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage.
canavar.hyena/trait:pack-tactics: The hyena has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the hyena’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.ice-devil/action:ice-spear: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. or range 30/120 ft. Hit: 14 (2d8 + 5) Piercing damage plus 10 (3d6) Cold damage. Until the end of its next turn, the target can’t take a Bonus Action or Reaction, its Speed decreases by 10 feet, and it can move or take one action on its turn, not both. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the devil’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
canavar.ice-devil/action:ice-wall: The devil casts Wall of Ice (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).
canavar.ice-devil/action:multiattack: The devil makes three Ice Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a Tail attack.
canavar.ice-devil/action:tail: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Bludgeoning damage plus 18 (4d8) Cold damage.
canavar.ice-devil/trait:diabolical-restoration: If the devil dies outside the Nine Hells, its body disappears in sulfurous smoke, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Nine Hells.
canavar.ice-devil/trait:magic-resistance: The devil has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.ice-mephit/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
canavar.ice-mephit/action:fog-cloud: The mephit casts Fog Cloud, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
canavar.ice-mephit/action:frost-breath: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (3d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.ice-mephit/trait:death-burst: The mephit explodes when it dies. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.imp/action:invisibility: The imp casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
canavar.imp/action:shape-shift: The imp shape-shifts to resemble a rat (Speed 20 ft.), a raven (20 ft., Fly 60 ft.), or a spider (20 ft., Climb 20 ft.), or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except for its Speed. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
canavar.imp/action:sting: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
canavar.imp/trait:magic-resistance: The imp has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.incubus/action:multiattack: The incubus makes two Restless Touch attacks.
canavar.incubus/action:restless-touch: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 24 hours or until the incubus dies. Until the curse ends, the target gains no benefit from finishing Short Rests.
canavar.incubus/action:spellcasting: The incubus casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15): At Will: Disguise Self, Etherealness 1/Day Each: Dream, Hypnotic Pattern
canavar.incubus/bonus:nightmare: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature the incubus can see within 60 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it has the Unconscious condition for 1 hour, until it takes damage, or until a creature within 5 feet of it takes an action to wake it. Otherwise, the target takes 18 (4d8) Psychic damage.
canavar.incubus/trait:succubus-form: When the incubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into a Succubus, using that stat block instead of this one. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
canavar.invisible-stalker/action:multiattack: The stalker makes three Wind Swipe attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Vortex.
canavar.invisible-stalker/action:vortex: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 14, one Large or smaller creature in the stalker’s space. Failure: 7 (1d8 + 3) Thunder damage, and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Until the grapple ends, the target can’t cast spells with a Verbal component and takes 7 (2d6) Thunder damage at the start of each of the stalker’s turns.
canavar.invisible-stalker/action:wind-swipe: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Force damage.
canavar.invisible-stalker/trait:air-form: The stalker can enter an enemy’s space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
canavar.invisible-stalker/trait:invisibility: The stalker has the Invisible condition.
canavar.iron-golem/action:bladed-arm: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 20 (3d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Fire damage.
canavar.iron-golem/action:fiery-bolt: Ranged Attack Roll: +10, range 120 ft. Hit: 36 (8d8) Fire damage.
canavar.iron-golem/action:multiattack: The golem makes two attacks, using Bladed Arm or Fiery Bolt in any combination.
canavar.iron-golem/action:poison-breath: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 60-foot Cone. Failure: 55 (10d10) Poison damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.iron-golem/trait:fire-absorption: Whenever the golem is subjected to Fire damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Fire damage dealt.
canavar.iron-golem/trait:magic-resistance: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.jackal/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +1, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 (1d4 – 1) Piercing damage.
canavar.killer-whale/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 21 (5d6 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.killer-whale/trait:hold-breath: The whale can hold its breath for 30 minutes.
canavar.knight/action:greatsword: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.
canavar.knight/action:heavy-crossbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +2, range 100/400 ft. Hit: 11 (2d10) Piercing damage plus 4 (1d8) Radiant damage.
canavar.knight/action:multiattack: The knight makes two attacks, using Greatsword or Heavy Crossbow in any combination.
canavar.knight/reaction:parry: Trigger: The knight is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The knight adds 2 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
canavar.kobold-warrior/action:dagger: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.kobold-warrior/trait:pack-tactics: The kobold has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the kobold’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.kobold-warrior/trait:sunlight-sensitivit: While in sunlight, the kobold has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
canavar.kraken/action:fling: The kraken throws a Large or smaller creature Grappled by it to a space it can see within 60 feet of itself that isn’t in the air. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, the creature thrown and each creature in the destination space. Failure: 18 (4d8) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
canavar.kraken/action:lightning-strike: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 23, one creature the kraken can see within 120 feet. Failure: 33 (6d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.kraken/action:multiattack: The kraken makes two Tentacle attacks and uses Fling, Lightning Strike, or Swallow.
canavar.kraken/action:swallow: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature Grappled by the kraken (it can have up to four creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: 23 (3d8 + 10) Piercing damage. If the target is Large or smaller, it is swallowed and no longer Grappled. A swallowed creature has the Restrained condition, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the kraken, and takes 24 (7d6) Acid damage at the start of each of its turns. If the kraken takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the kraken must succeed on a DC 25 Constitution saving throw at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within 10 feet of the kraken with the Prone condition. If the kraken dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using 15 feet of movement, exiting Prone.
canavar.kraken/action:tentacle: Melee Attack Roll: +17, reach 30 ft. Hit: 24 (4d6 + 10) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 20) from one of ten tentacles, and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
canavar.kraken/legendary:toxic-ink: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 23, each creature in a 15-foot Emanation originating from the kraken while it is underwater. Failure: The target has the Blinded and Poisoned conditions until the end of the kraken’s next turn. The kraken then moves up to its Speed. Failure or Success: The kraken can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.kraken/trait:amphibious: The kraken can breathe air and water.
canavar.kraken/trait:legendary-resistance: If the kraken fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
canavar.kraken/trait:siege-monster: The kraken deals double damage to objects and structures.
canavar.lamia/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Psychic damage.
canavar.lamia/action:corrupting-touch: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 13, one creature the lamia can see within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage, and the target is cursed for 1 hour. Until the curse ends, the target has the Charmed and Poisoned conditions.
canavar.lamia/action:multiattack: The lamia makes two Claw attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Corrupting Touch.
canavar.lamia/action:spellcasting: The lamia casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13): At Will: Disguise Self (can appear as a Large or Medium biped), Minor Illusion 1/Day Each: Geas, Major Image, Scrying
canavar.lamia/bonus:leap: The lamia jumps up to 30 feet by spending 10 feet of movement.
canavar.lemure/action:vile-slime: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
canavar.lemure/trait:hellish-restoration: If the lemure dies in the Nine Hells, it revives with all its Hit Points in 1d10 days unless it is killed by a creature under the effects of a Bless spell or its remains are sprinkled with Holy Water.
canavar.lich/action:eldritch-burst: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 31 (4d12 + 5) Force damage.
canavar.lich/action:multiattack: The lich makes three attacks, using Eldritch Burst or Paralyzing Touch in any combination.
canavar.lich/action:paralyzing-touch: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (3d6 + 5) Cold damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the start of the lich’s next turn.
canavar.lich/action:spellcasting: The lich casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20): At Will: Detect Magic, Detect Thoughts, Dispel Magic, Fireball (level 5 version), Invisibility, Lightning Bolt (level 5 version), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation 2/Day Each: Animate Dead, Dimension Door, Plane Shift 1/Day Each: Chain Lightning, Finger of Death, Power Word Kill, Scrying
canavar.lich/legendary:deathly-teleport: The lich teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and each creature within 10 feet of the space it left takes 11 (2d10) Necrotic damage.
canavar.lich/legendary:disrupt-life: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each creature that isn’t an Undead in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the lich. Failure: 31 (9d6) Necrotic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The lich can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.lich/legendary:frightening-gaze: The lich casts Fear, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The lich can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.lich/reaction:protective-magic: The lich casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.lich/trait:legendary-resistance: If the lich fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
canavar.lich/trait:spirit-jar: If destroyed, the lich reforms in 1d10 days if it has a spirit jar, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the lich’s lair.
canavar.lion/action:multiattack: The lion makes two Rend attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Roar.
canavar.lion/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.lion/action:roar: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature within 15 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of the lion’s next turn.
canavar.lion/trait:pack-tactics: The lion has Advantage on an attack roll against a creature if at least one of the lion’s allies is within 5 feet of the creature and the ally doesn’t have the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.lion/trait:running-leap: With a 10-foot running start, the lion can Long Jump up to 25 feet.
canavar.lizard/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage.
canavar.lizard/trait:spider-climb: The lizard can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
canavar.mage/action:arcane-burst: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 16 (3d8 + 3) Force damage.
canavar.mage/action:multiattack: The mage makes three Arcane Burst attacks.
canavar.mage/action:spellcasting: The mage casts one of the following spells, using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Magic, Light, Mage Armor (included in AC), Mage Hand, Prestidigitation 2/Day Each: Fireball (level 4 version), Invisibility 1/Day Each: Cone of Cold, Fly
canavar.mage/bonus:misty-step: The mage casts Misty Step, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.mage/reaction:protective-magic: The mage casts Counterspell or Shield in response to the spell’s trigger, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.magma-mephit/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 3 (1d4 + 1) Slashing damage plus 3 (1d6) Fire damage.
canavar.magma-mephit/action:fire-breath: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.magma-mephit/trait:death-burst: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.magmin/action:touch: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d4 + 2) Fire damage. If the target is a creature or a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it starts burning.
canavar.magmin/bonus:ignited-illumination: The magmin sets itself ablaze or extinguishes its flames. While ablaze, the magmin sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet.
canavar.magmin/trait:death-burst: The magmin explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the magmin. Failure: 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.mammoth/action:gore: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 10 ft. Hit: 18 (2d10 + 7) Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the mammoth moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target has the Prone condition.
canavar.mammoth/action:multiattack: The mammoth makes two Gore attacks.
canavar.mammoth/bonus:trample: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, one creature within 5 feet that has the Prone condition. Failure: 29 (4d10 + 7) Bludgeoning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.manticore/action:multiattack: The manticore makes three attacks, using Rend or Tail Spike in any combination.
canavar.manticore/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.manticore/action:tail-spike: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 100/200 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.marilith/action:constrict: Strength Saving Throw: DC 17, one Medium or smaller creature the marilith can see within 5 feet. Failure: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
canavar.marilith/action:multiattack: The marilith makes six Pact Blade attacks and uses Constrict.
canavar.marilith/action:pact-blade: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 5) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage.
canavar.marilith/bonus:teleport: The marilith teleports up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space it can see.
canavar.marilith/reaction:parry: Trigger: The marilith is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. Response: The marilith adds 5 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
canavar.marilith/trait:demonic-restoration: If the marilith dies outside the Abyss, its body dissolves into ichor, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in the Abyss.
canavar.marilith/trait:magic-resistance: The marilith has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.marilith/trait:reactive: The marilith can take one Reaction on every turn of combat.
canavar.mastiff/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Piercing damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.medusa/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.medusa/action:multiattack: The medusa makes two Claw attacks and one Snake Hair attack, or it makes three Poison Ray attacks.
canavar.medusa/action:poison-ray: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 150 ft. Hit: 11 (2d8 + 2) Poison damage.
canavar.medusa/action:snake-hair: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
canavar.medusa/bonus:petrifying-gaze: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. If the medusa sees its reflection in the Cone, the medusa must make this save. First Failure: The target has the Restrained condition and repeats the save at the end of its next turn if it is still Restrained, ending the effect on itself on a success. Second Failure: The target has the Petrified condition instead of the Restrained condition.
canavar.merfolk-skirmisher/action:ocean-spear: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 3 (1d6) Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage. If the target is a creature, its Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the merfolk’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
canavar.merfolk-skirmisher/trait:amphibious: The merfolk can breathe air and water.
canavar.merrow/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of the merrow’s next turn.
canavar.merrow/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage.
canavar.merrow/action:harpoon: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, the merrow pulls the target up to 15 feet straight toward itself.
canavar.merrow/action:multiattack: The merrow makes two attacks, using Bite, Claw, or Harpoon in any combination.
canavar.merrow/trait:amphibious: The merrow can breathe air and water.
canavar.mimic/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target is Grappled by the mimic), reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Piercing damage—or 12 (2d8 + 3) Piercing damage if the target is Grappled by the mimic—plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.
canavar.mimic/action:pseudopod: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (1d8 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
canavar.mimic/bonus:shape-shift: The mimic shape-shifts to resemble a Medium or Small object while retaining its game statistics, or it returns to its true blob form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
canavar.mimic/trait:adhesive: The mimic adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the mimic has the Grappled condition (escape DC 13). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
canavar.minotaur-of-baphomet/action:abyssal-glai: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 10 ft. Hit: 10 (1d12 + 4) Slashing damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage.
canavar.minotaur-of-baphomet/action:gore: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 18 (4d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the minotaur moved 10+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 10 (3d6) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.
canavar.minotaur-skeleton/action:gore: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature and the skeleton moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 9 (2d8) Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.
canavar.minotaur-skeleton/action:slam: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.mule/action:hooves: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d4 + 2) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.mule/trait:beast-of-burden: The mule counts as one size larger for the purpose of determining its carrying capacity.
canavar.mummy-lord/action:channel-negative-energ: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60 ft. Hit: 25 (6d6 + 4) Necrotic damage.
canavar.mummy-lord/action:dreadful-glare: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: 25 (6d6 + 4) Psychic damage, and the target has the Paralyzed condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.
canavar.mummy-lord/action:multiattack: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack, and it uses Dreadful Glare.
canavar.mummy-lord/action:rotting-fist: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, it gains no benefit from finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. A creature dies and turns to dust if reduced to 0 Hit Points by this attack.
canavar.mummy-lord/action:spellcasting: The mummy casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17, +9 to hit with spell attacks): At Will: Dispel Magic, Thaumaturgy 1/Day Each: Animate Dead, Harm, Insect Plague (level 7 version)
canavar.mummy-lord/legendary:dread-command: The mummy casts Command (level 2 version), using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.mummy-lord/legendary:glare: The mummy uses Dreadful Glare. The mummy can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.mummy-lord/legendary:necrotic-strike: The mummy makes one Rotting Fist or Channel Negative Energy attack.
canavar.mummy-lord/reaction:whirlwind-of-sand: Trigger: The mummy is hit by an attack roll. Response: The mummy adds 2 to its AC against the attack, possibly causing the attack to miss, and the mummy teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Each creature of its choice that it can see within 5 feet of its destination space has the Blinded condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn.
canavar.mummy-lord/trait:legendary-resistance: If the mummy fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
canavar.mummy-lord/trait:magic-resistance: The mummy has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.mummy-lord/trait:undead-restoration: If destroyed, the mummy gains a new body in 24 hours if its heart is intact, reviving with all its Hit Points. The new body appears in an unoccupied space within the mummy’s lair. The heart is a Tiny object that has AC 17, HP 10, and Immunity to all damage except Fire.
canavar.mummy/action:dreadful-glare: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one creature the mummy can see within 60 feet. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of the mummy’s next turn. Success: The target is immune to this mummy’s Dreadful Glare for 24 hours.
canavar.mummy/action:multiattack: The mummy makes two Rotting Fist attacks and uses Dreadful Glare.
canavar.mummy/action:rotting-fist: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (1d10 + 3) Bludgeoning damage plus 10 (3d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, it is cursed. While cursed, the target can’t regain Hit Points, its Hit Point maximum doesn’t return to normal when finishing a Long Rest, and its Hit Point maximum decreases by 10 (3d6) every 24 hours that elapse. canavar.rust-monster/action:antennae: The rust monster targets one nonmagical metal object—armor or a weapon—worn or carried by a creature within 5 feet of itself. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 11, the creature with the object. Failure: The object takes a −1 penalty to the AC it offers (armor) or to its attack rolls (weapon). Armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its AC to 10, and a weapon is destroyed if its penalty reaches −5. The penalty can be removed by casting the Mending spell on the armor or weapon.
canavar.rust-monster/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) Piercing damage.
canavar.rust-monster/action:destroy-metal: The rust monster touches a nonmagical metal object within 5 feet of itself that isn’t being worn or carried. The touch destroys a 1-foot Cube of the object.
canavar.rust-monster/action:multiattack: The rust monster makes one Bite attack and uses Antennae twice.
canavar.rust-monster/reaction:reflexive-antennae: Trigger: An attack roll hits the rust monster. Response: The rust monster uses Antennae.
canavar.rust-monster/trait:iron-scent: The rust monster can pinpoint the location of ferrous metal within 30 feet of itself.
canavar.saber-toothed-tiger/action:multiattack: The tiger makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.saber-toothed-tiger/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Slashing damage.
canavar.saber-toothed-tiger/bonus:nimble-escape: The tiger takes the Disengage or Hide action.
canavar.saber-toothed-tiger/trait:running-leap: With a 10-foot running start, the tiger can Long Jump up to 25 feet.
canavar.sahuagin-warrior/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) Slashing damage.
canavar.sahuagin-warrior/action:multiattack: The sahuagin makes two Claw attacks.
canavar.sahuagin-warrior/bonus:aquatic-charge: The sahuagin swims up to its Swim Speed straight toward an enemy it can see.
canavar.sahuagin-warrior/trait:blood-frenzy: The sahuagin has Advantage on attack rolls against any creature that doesn’t have all its Hit Points.
canavar.sahuagin-warrior/trait:limited-amphibiou: The sahuagin can breathe air and water, but it must be submerged at least once every 4 hours to avoid suffocating outside water.
canavar.sahuagin-warrior/trait:shark-telepathy: The sahuagin can magically control sharks within 120 feet of itself, using a special telepathy.
canavar.salamander/action:constrict: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Large or smaller creature the salamander can see within 10 feet. Failure: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. The target has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends.
canavar.salamander/action:flame-spear: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Fire damage. Hit or Miss: The spear magically returns to the salamander’s hand immediately after a ranged attack.
canavar.salamander/action:multiattack: The salamander makes two Flame Spear attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Constrict.
canavar.salamander/trait:fire-aura: At the end of each of the salamander’s turns, each creature of the salamander’s choice in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the salamander takes 7 (2d6) Fire damage.
canavar.satyr/action:hooves: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the satyr pushes the target up to 10 feet straight away from itself.
canavar.satyr/action:mockery: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 12, one creature the satyr can see within 90 feet. Failure: 5 (1d6 + 2) Psychic damage.
canavar.satyr/trait:magic-resistance: The satyr has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.scorpion/action:sting: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 3 (1d6) Poison damage.
canavar.scout/action:longbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 150/600 ft. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.scout/action:multiattack: The scout makes two attacks, using Shortsword and Longbow in any combination.
canavar.scout/action:shortsword: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage.
canavar.sea-hag/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) Slashing damage.
canavar.sea-hag/action:death-glare: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, one Frightened creature the hag can see within 30 feet. Failure: If the target has 20 Hit Points or fewer, it drops to 0 Hit Points. Otherwise, the target takes 13 (3d8) Psychic damage.
canavar.sea-hag/action:illusory-appearance: The hag casts Disguise Self, using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13). The spell’s duration is 24 hours.
canavar.sea-hag/trait:amphibious: The hag can breathe air and water.
canavar.sea-hag/trait:coven-magic: While within 30 feet of at least two hag allies, the hag can cast one of the following spells, requiring no Material components, using the spell’s normal casting time, and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 11): Augury, Find Familiar, Identify, Locate Object, Scrying, or Unseen Servant. The hag must finish a Long Rest before using this trait to cast that spell again.
canavar.sea-hag/trait:vile-appearance: Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 11, any Beast or Humanoid that starts its turn within 30 feet of the hag and can see the hag’s true form. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. Success: The target is immune to this hag’s Vile Appearance for 24 hours.
canavar.seahorse/action:bubble-dash: While underwater, the seahorse moves up to its Swim Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
canavar.seahorse/trait:water-breathing: The seahorse can breathe only underwater.
canavar.shadow/action:draining-swipe: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Necrotic damage, and the target’s Strength score decreases by 1d4. The target dies if this reduces that score to 0. If a Humanoid is slain by this attack, a Shadow rises from the corpse 1d4 hours later.
canavar.shadow/bonus:shadow-stealth: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the shadow takes the Hide action.
canavar.shadow/trait:amorphous: The shadow can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without expending extra movement to do so.
canavar.shadow/trait:sunlight-weakness: While in sunlight, the shadow has Disadvantage on D20 Tests.
canavar.shambling-mound/action:charged-tendril: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 5 (2d4) Lightning damage. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, the shambling mound pulls the target 5 feet straight toward itself.
canavar.shambling-mound/action:engulf: Strength Saving Throw: DC 15, one Medium or smaller creature within 5 feet. Failure: The target is pulled into the shambling mound’s space and has the Grappled condition (escape DC 14). Until the grapple ends, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, and it takes 10 (3d6) Lightning damage at the start of each of its turns. When the shambling mound moves, the Grappled target moves with it, costing it no extra movement. The shambling mound can have only one creature Grappled by this action at a time.
canavar.shambling-mound/action:multiattack: The shambling mound makes three Charged Tendril attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Engulf.
canavar.shambling-mound/trait:lightning-absorpti: Whenever the shambling mound is subjected to Lightning damage, it regains a number of Hit Points equal to the Lightning damage dealt.
canavar.shield-guardian/action:fist: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 11 (2d6 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Force damage.
canavar.shield-guardian/action:multiattack: The guardian makes two Fist attacks.
canavar.shield-guardian/reaction:protection: Trigger: An attack roll hits the wearer of the guardian’s amulet while the wearer is within 5 feet of the guardian. Response: The wearer gains a +5 bonus to AC, including against the triggering attack and possibly causing it to miss, until the start of the guardian’s next turn.
canavar.shield-guardian/trait:bound: The guardian is magically bound to an amulet. While the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet’s wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within 60 feet of the amulet’s wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (round up) is transferred to the guardian.
canavar.shield-guardian/trait:regeneration: The guardian regains 10 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns if it has at least 1 Hit Point.
canavar.shield-guardian/trait:spell-storing: A spellcaster who wears the guardian’s amulet can cause the guardian to store one spell of level 4 or lower. To do so, the wearer must cast the spell on the guardian while within 5 feet of it. The spell has no effect but is stored within the guardian. Any previously stored spell is lost when a new spell is stored. The guardian can cast the spell stored with any parameters set by the original caster, requiring no spell components and using the caster’s spellcasting ability. The stored spell is then lost.
canavar.shrieker-fungus/reaction:shriek: Trigger: A creature or a source of Bright Light moves within 30 feet of the shrieker. Response: The shrieker emits a shriek audible within 300 feet of itself for 1 minute or until the shrieker dies.
canavar.silver-dragon-wyrmling/action:cold-breat: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 18 (4d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.silver-dragon-wyrmling/action:multiattac: The dragon makes two Rend attacks.
canavar.silver-dragon-wyrmling/action:paralyzing: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. First Failure: The target has the Incapacitated condition until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. Second Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically.
canavar.silver-dragon-wyrmling/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 9 (1d10 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.skeleton/action:shortbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +5, range 80/320 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.skeleton/action:shortsword: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage.
canavar.solar/action:flying-sword: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: +15, reach 10 ft. or range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d6 + 8) Slashing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage. Hit or Miss: The sword magically returns to the solar’s hand or hovers within 5 feet of the solar immediately after a ranged attack.
canavar.solar/action:multiattack: The solar makes two Flying Sword attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Slaying Bow.
canavar.solar/action:slaying-bow: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 21, one creature the solar can see within 600 feet. Failure: If the creature has 100 Hit Points or fewer, it dies. It otherwise takes 24 (4d8 + 6) Piercing damage plus 36 (8d8) Radiant damage.
canavar.solar/action:spellcasting: The solar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 25): At Will: Detect Evil and Good 1/Day Each: Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Resurrection
canavar.solar/bonus:divine-aid: The solar casts Cure Wounds (level 2 version), Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
canavar.solar/legendary:blinding-gaze: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 25, one creature the solar can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Failure or Success: The solar can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.solar/legendary:radiant-teleport: The solar teleports up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space it can see. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 25, each creature in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the solar at its destination space. Failure: 11 (2d10) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.solar/trait:divine-awareness: The solar knows if it hears a lie.
canavar.solar/trait:exalted-restoration: If the solar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.
canavar.solar/trait:legendary-resistance: If the solar fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
canavar.solar/trait:magic-resistance: The solar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.specter/action:life-drain: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 7 (2d6) Necrotic damage. If the target is a creature, its Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
canavar.specter/trait:incorporeal-movement: The specter can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.
canavar.specter/trait:sunlight-sensitivity: While in sunlight, the specter has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.
canavar.sphinx-of-lore/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +8, reach 5 ft. Hit: 14 (3d6 + 4) Slashing damage.

canavar.sphinx-of-lore/action:multiattack: The sphinx makes three Claw attacks.
canavar.sphinx-of-lore/action:spellcasting: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 16): At Will: Detect Magic, Identify, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Prestidigitation 1/Day Each: Dispel Magic, Legend Lore, Locate Object, Plane Shift, Remove Curse, Tongues
canavar.sphinx-of-lore/legendary:arcane-prowl: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.
canavar.sphinx-of-lore/legendary:weight-of-years: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. canavar.sphinx-of-lore/trait:inscrutable: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
canavar.sphinx-of-lore/trait:legendary-resistanc: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d6 + 6) Slashing damage.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/action:multiattack: The sphinx makes two Claw attacks and uses Roar.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/action:roar: The sphinx emits a magical roar. Whenever it roars, the roar has a different effect, as detailed below (the sequence resets when it takes a Long Rest): First Roar. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Frightened condition for 1 minute. Second Roar. Wisdom Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: The target has the Paralyzed condition, and it repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After 1 minute, it succeeds automatically. Third Roar. Constitution Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 500-foot Emanation originating from the sphinx. Failure: 44 (8d10) Thunder damage, and the target has the Prone condition. Success: Half damage only.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/action:spellcasting: The sphinx casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20): At Will: Detect Evil and Good, Thaumaturgy 1/Day Each: Detect Magic, Dispel Magic, Greater Restoration, Heroes’ Feast, Zone of Truth
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/legendary:arcane-prowl: The sphinx can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space it can see, and it makes one Claw attack.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/legendary:weight-of-year: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 16, one creature the sphinx can see within 120 feet. Failure: The target gains 1 Exhaustion level. While the target has any Exhaustion levels, it appears 3d10 years older. Failure or Success: The sphinx can’t take this action again until the start of its next turn.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/trait:inscrutable: No magic can observe the sphinx remotely or detect its thoughts without its permission. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to ascertain its intentions or sincerity are made with Disadvantage.
canavar.sphinx-of-valor/trait:legendary-resistan: If the sphinx fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.
canavar.sphinx-of-wonder/action:rend: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Radiant damage.
canavar.sphinx-of-wonder/reaction:burst-of-ingen: Trigger: The sphinx or another creature within 30 feet makes an ability check or a saving throw. Response: The sphinx adds 2 to the roll.
canavar.sphinx-of-wonder/trait:magic-resistance: The sphinx has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.spider/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage plus 2 (1d4) Poison damage.
canavar.spider/trait:spider-climb: The spider can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
canavar.spider/trait:web-walker: The spider ignores movement restrictions caused by webs, and the spider knows the location of any other creature in contact with the same web.
canavar.spirit-naga/action:bite: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 7 (1d6 + 4) Piercing damage plus 14 (4d6) Poison damage.
canavar.spirit-naga/action:multiattack: The naga makes three attacks, using Bite or Necrotic Ray in any combination.
canavar.spirit-naga/action:necrotic-ray: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 60 ft. Hit: 21 (6d6) Necrotic damage.
canavar.spirit-naga/action:spellcasting: The naga casts one of the following spells, requiring no Somatic or Material components and using Intelligence as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14): At Will: Detect Magic, Mage Hand, Minor Illusion, Water Breathing 2/Day Each: Detect Thoughts, Dimension Door, Hold Person (level 3 version), Lightning Bolt (level 4 version)
canavar.spirit-naga/trait:fiendish-restoration: If it dies, the naga returns to life in 1d6 days and regains all its Hit Points. Only a Wish spell can prevent this trait from functioning.
canavar.sprite/action:enchanting-bow: Ranged Attack Roll: +6, range 40/160 ft. Hit: 1 Piercing damage, and the target has the Charmed condition until the start of the sprite’s next turn.
canavar.sprite/action:heart-sight: Charisma Saving Throw: DC 10, one creature within 5 feet the sprite can see (Celestials, Fiends, and Undead automatically fail the save). Failure: The sprite knows the target’s emotions and alignment.
canavar.sprite/action:invisibility: The sprite casts Invisibility on itself, requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability.
canavar.sprite/action:needle-sword: Melee Attack Roll: +6, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d4 + 4) Piercing damage.
canavar.spy/action:hand-crossbow: Ranged Attack Roll: +4, range 30/120 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
canavar.spy/action:shortsword: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) Piercing damage plus 7 (2d6) Poison damage.
canavar.spy/bonus:cunning-action: The spy takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.
canavar.steam-mephit/action:claw: Melee Attack Roll: +2, reach 5 ft. Hit: 2 (1d4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Fire damage.
canavar.steam-mephit/action:steam-breath: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage, and the target’s Speed decreases by 10 feet until the end of the mephit’s next turn. Success: Half damage only. Failure or Success: Being underwater doesn’t grant Resistance to this Fire damage.
canavar.steam-mephit/trait:blurred-form: Attack rolls against the mephit are made with Disadvantage unless the mephit has the Incapacitated condition.
canavar.steam-mephit/trait:death-burst: The mephit explodes when it dies. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 10, each creature in a 5-foot Emanation originating from the mephit. Failure: 5 (2d4) Fire damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.stirge/action:proboscis: Melee Attack Roll: +5, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (1d6 + 3) Piercing damage, and the stirge attaches to the target. While attached, the stirge can’t make Proboscis attacks, and the target takes 5 (2d4) Necrotic damage at the start of each of the stirge’s turns. The stirge can detach itself by spending 5 feet of its movement. The target or a creature within 5 feet of it can detach the stirge as an action.
canavar.stone-giant/action:boulder: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 60/240 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.stone-giant/action:multiattack: The giant makes two attacks, using Stone Club or Boulder in any combination.
canavar.stone-giant/action:stone-club: Melee Attack Roll: +9, reach 15 ft. Hit: 22 (3d10 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.
canavar.stone-giant/reaction:deflect-missile: Trigger: The giant is hit by a ranged attack roll and takes Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage from it. Response: The giant reduces the damage it takes from the attack by 11 (1d10 + 6), and if that damage is reduced to 0, the giant can redirect some of the attack’s force. Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 17, one creature the giant can see within 60 feet. Failure: 11 (1d10 + 6) Force damage.
canavar.stone-golem/action:force-bolt: Ranged Attack Roll: +9, range 120 ft. Hit: 22 (4d10) Force damage.
canavar.stone-golem/action:multiattack: The golem makes two attacks, using Slam or Force Bolt in any combination.
canavar.stone-golem/action:slam: Melee Attack Roll: +10, reach 5 ft. Hit: 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 9 (2d8) Force damage.
canavar.stone-golem/bonus:slow: The golem casts the Slow spell, requiring no spell components and using Constitution as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 17).
canavar.stone-golem/trait:magic-resistance: The golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
canavar.storm-giant/action:lightning-storm: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 18, each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder originating from a point the giant can see within 500 feet. Failure: 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success: Half damage.
canavar.storm-giant/action:multiattack: The giant makes two attacks, using Storm Sword or Thunderbolt in any combination.
canavar.storm-giant/action:spellcasting: The giant casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 18): At Will: Detect Magic, Light 1/Day: Control Weather
canavar.storm-giant/action:storm-sword: Melee Attack Roll: +14, reach 10 ft. Hit: 23 (4d6 + 9) Slashing damage plus 13 (3d8) Lightning damage.
canavar.storm-giant/action:thunderbolt: Ranged Attack Roll: +14, range 500 ft. Hit: 22 (2d12 + 9) Lightning damage, and the target has the Blinded and Deafened conditions until the start of the giant’s next turn.
canavar.storm-giant/trait:amphibious: The giant can breathe air and water.
canavar.succubus/action:charm: The succubus casts Dominate Person (level 8 version), requiring no spell components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 15).
canavar.succubus/action:draining-kiss: Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, one creature Charmed by the succubus within 5 feet. Failure: 13 (3d8) Psychic damage. Success: Half damage. Failure or Success: The target’s Hit Point maximum decreases by an amount equal to the damage taken.
canavar.succubus/action:fiendish-touch: Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 5 ft. Hit: 16 (2d10 + 5) Psychic damage.
canavar.succubus/action:multiattack: The succubus makes one Fiendish Touch attack and uses Charm or Draining Kiss.
canavar.succubus/bonus:shape-shift: The succubus shape-shifts into a Medium or Small Humanoid, or it returns to its true form. Its game statistics are the same in each form, except its Fly Speed is available only in its true form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn’t transformed.
canavar.succubus/trait:incubus-form: When the succubus finishes a Long Rest, it can shape-shift into an Incubus, using that stat block instead of this one.
canavar.swarm-of-bats/action:bites: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 5 (2d4) Piercing damage, or 2 (1d4) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.
canavar.swarm-of-bats/trait:swarm: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny bat. The swarm can’t regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
canavar.swarm-of-crawling-claws/action:swarm-of-: Melee Attack Roll: +4, reach 5 ft. Hit: 20 (4d8 + 2) Necrotic damage, or 11 (2d8 + 2) Necrotic damage if the swarm is Bloodied. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the Prone condition.
canavar.swarm-of-crawling-claws/trait:swarm: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny creature. The swarm can’t regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
canavar.swarm-of-insects/action:bites: Melee Attack Roll: +3, reach 5 ft. Hit: 6 (2d4 + 1) Poison damage, or 3 (1d4 + 1) Poison damage if the swarm is Bloodied.
canavar.swarm-of-insects/trait:spider-climb: If the swarm has a Climb Speed, the swarm can climb difficult surfaces, including along ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.
canavar.swarm-of-insects/trait:swarm: The swarm can occupy another creature’s space and vice versa, and the swarm can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny insect. The swarm can’t regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.
canavar.swarm-of-piranhas/action:bites: Melee Attack Roll: +5 (with Advantage if the target doesn’t have all its Hit Points), reach 5 ft. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) Piercing damage, or 5 (1d4 + 3) Piercing damage if the swarm is Bloodied.
